scientific_integrity: The exact universal angular/stepsize boundary follows from algebraic identities and a sharp two-dimensional witness; standalone rational tests check representative instances but cannot establish the infinite-dimensional quantifiers. Priority comparisons are qualified by inaccessible contemporary texts.
scientific_limitations: Quadratic nonsingular indefinite objectives, fixed SPD metric and exact orthogonal inexact frames; contraction is in the absolute-preconditioned-Hessian norm, not the original metric norm; no nonlinear local stability, variable SPD metric, nonorthogonal-frame or eigensolver-complexity claim.
title: Sharp principal-angle and stepsize stability for inexact high-index saddle reflections
